title: Big's Backyard Ultra home page — World Team Championship 2026 and global format figures
claims: The 2026 World Team Championship started Saturday 17 October 2026 at 07:00 CDT as a national-team event staged simultaneously at satellite venues worldwide.
The 2026 team title was won by the United States with 1,120 yards, 51 ahead of Australia on 1,069; Belgium were third on 1,058 and ran the last national race to yard 124.

Belgium are the defending team champions with a benchmark of 1,147 yards set in 2024; in that Belgian satellite race Merijn Geerts, Ivo Steyaert and Frank Gielen all reached 110 yards (458.33 miles) and finished level, so the race ended without an individual last one standing.
The format statistics published on the home page: 55,000 athletes competed in the past year across 82 countries; 4,396 athletes ran 24 hours or longer; 708 affiliated races.
Lazarus Lake is quoted as the founder, based in Bell Buckle, Tennessee.
